# Pre-sales Wave

## Purpose

Transform an approved Work Order into the first set of project artefacts required to continue with detailed design.

This phase produces:

- Requirements
- Initial Architecture
- High Level Plan

No implementation artefacts are allowed.

---

## Mandatory Inputs

Read:

- governance/constitution.md
- governance/technology-profile.yaml
- docs/01_work_order.md

Apply:

- .github/copilot-instructions.md

---

## Responsibilities

Identify:

- Business objectives
- Functional requirements
- Non-functional requirements
- Integrations
- Constraints
- Risks
- Assumptions
- Open decisions

---

## Required Outputs

Generate only:

- docs/02_requirements.md
- docs/03_initial_architecture.md
- docs/04_high_level_plan.md

---

## Restrictions

Do not:

- Generate code
- Generate APIs
- Generate database design
- Generate implementation tasks
- Generate detailed technical design

---

## Validation Criteria

Before completion verify:

- All use cases are covered
- All integrations are identified
- Scope boundaries are respected
- Open questions are explicitly documented

---

## Completion Criteria

Phase is complete when:

- Requirements exist
- Initial architecture exists
- High level plan exists
- Coverage check is successful
